identity.selection_owner: private chezmoi consumer; independent of the code bundle pin

desktop.consumer_status: deployed and converged on Carbon, Starship, and Snap
desktop.evidence: 16 shared files were byte-identical; scoped repeats were no-ops; services, processes, and captured policy were preserved.

shell.consumer_status: deployed and PTY-qualified on Carbon, Starship, and Snap
shell.evidence: Owned full-prompt PTY checks passed on all three hosts; scoped repeats were no-ops and existing sessions were preserved.
shell.runtime_cache_evidence: The private verifier validates each known Powerlevel10k .zwc single-file header and layout, then compares every loaded byte and mode against a fresh compilation. Only validated 0-3 unused alignment bytes at the end of each endian half are normalized. Extra caches and loaded-byte, metadata, or mode changes are rejected; upstream caching is retained.

appearance.consumer_status: deployed and converged on Carbon, Starship, and Snap
appearance.evidence: Thirty-five scoped targets converged with zero drift and repeat runs made no writes. All 39 derived outputs per host matched the same approved receipt byte-for-byte; all 45 pre-change/native comparisons passed. Native process counts (8/8/9), eleven service identities per host, package state, and 25 protected root-owned files with their bytes, modes, ownership, and mtimes were preserved. The greeter hook repeat made no writes; no SDDM restart was needed. Guarded greeter execution passed for all three host profiles with zero privileged-write requests; six isolated toolkit checks and four reviewed images passed.

independent_selections.code_bundle: The consumer pins one immutable archive and manifest; module admission is selected separately by host.
independent_selections.appearance_identity: The schema-2 identity has its own SHA-256 and can change independently of renderer code.
independent_selections.utility_admission: Private chezmoi owns utility host selection; publishing the desktop module does not enroll a host.
independent_selections.shell_dependencies: components/shell/pins.json records upstream revisions; dependency staging is explicit and separate from shell startup.
independent_selections.personal_environment_and_policy: Private chezmoi owns user environment, machine policy, host admission, native preference projection, and privileged root greeter installation.
